summary.text: This opportunity briefing examines the combination of the PC algorithm, causal discovery, and prediction to simultaneously perform causal network inference and forecasting. Causal discovery methods reconstruct interaction networks, while predictive models evaluate which candidate edges genuinely improve system dynamics forecasting. A predictive model uses candidate edges from constraint-based causal discovery to prune false positives and refine the causal network.
